title: The Whale That Drank the Lake
story: High above Quillrest Tarn, a whale made of storm-cloud has dipped its snout into the mountain reservoir and begun to drink. The silver moon-carp below flap in panic — once the water falls to the stranding line, they will be left gasping on the stones. Mr 6 hauls open the snowmelt sluice gate with both arms and starts counting.
question: Mistralon drinks 200 gallons every minute while the sluice pours 125 gallons back in, and the water sits 1200 gallons above the stranding line — how many minutes does Mr 6 have to lift every moon-carp to safety?
solution: Each minute the reservoir really loses 200 - 125 = 75 gallons.
Mr 6 has 16 minutes before the water hits the stranding line.
praise: Dividing to find the time was exactly right — the missing step was subtracting the sluice's refill first, so the whale only really wins 75 gallons a minute.
hint: The whale takes water out while the sluice puts water back. What is the water level's TRUE loss in one minute?
victory: Mr 6 scooped the last moon-carp into his helmet with four seconds to spare, and Mistralon — embarrassed to be out-counted by a numeral — drifted off to drink a cloud instead.
imagePrompt: A vast translucent storm-cloud whale lowering its snout into a moonlit mountain reservoir while a small knightly numeral 6 in a blue cape heaves open a stone sluice gate, silver carp flashing in the shallows.
